All the members of the Royal Guard were Shinigami acknowledged by the Soul King to have made significant contributions to the history of Soul Society.

entries.name: Heilig Bogen
entries.content: The bow generated from Reishi by a Quincy.

entries.name: Heilig Pfeil
entries.content: Heilig Pfeil (Holy Arrow) are the primary attack used by Quincy. Spiritual energy formed into the shape of an arrow that is capable of injuring and/or killing spiritual beings. The arrows can be created by collecting Reishi, absorbing Reiryoku from an opponent or gathering spirit energy, giving the Quincy many ways to form their arrows. They are the Quincy equivalent of an average arrow, but if the arrows are shot continuously, they can eventually injure the wielders' hands. The strength of the arrow can vary between users

entries.name: Jigoku no Gaki
entries.content: Jigoku no Gaki (Beasts of Hell) are massive Hollows uniquely originating from Hell. While their appearances vary wildly, common visual motifs between them include large rings protruding from or comprising parts of their bodies and thick chain patterns on their skin. In addition to possessing great strength befitting their size, they do not emit any Reiatsu, allowing them to sneak up on even spiritually-aware Shinigami.

entries.name: Jinzen
entries.content:
This method is the only way to carry on a proper conversation with one's Zanpakutō. One places their sword over their lap, takes a meditative pose, and forces their mind to become one with the Zanpakutō.

In this form, one can call out the true form of the powers of their Zanpakutō. In this form, one enters a state of calm to enter the inner world of the Zanpakutō and engage them there. In this state, a wielder will have to fight their Zanpakutō spirit in order to attain access to new abilities. Unwilling to teach its owner these abilities, the Zanpakutō spirit engages its wielder in a battle, the likes of which has never taken place before.

In this meditative state, one is so deeply entranced, even sustained wounds are ignored. Any form of injury sustained in the inner world while in this meditative state is reflected in the real world.

entries.name: Zanpakutō Training
entries.content: It is not enough to simply know the name of one's Zanpakutō. If a wielder were to lend its power to its Zanpakutō, the weapon would become stronger. To fully use a Zanpakutō's power, a wielder must get to know its Zanpakutō's spirit.

entries.name: Kōryū
entries.content: The current that is constantly flowing through the Dangai, in order to prevent enemies such as Hollows from using it. The current stops souls from moving, and even one foot caught by it makes escape almost impossible. It encompasses the walls, capturing anyone who makes contact with them.

entries.name: Kaikyō Kotei
entries.content:
A method referred to as Kaikyō Kotei (Boundary Fixation). Normally, lower-echelon Shinigami enter the dimension in great numbers and using a special method, pour in their Reiatsu to fixate the current. However, individuals in possession of significant quantities of Reiatsu can single-handedly suppress the current for extended periods of time, but only after the insertion of four small forked blades into various locations along the Dangai's wall, and as long as the user remains connected to these items for the duration. Isshin Kurosaki states that someone with his level of Reiatsu can maintain this state for no longer than 2000 hours, according to the time frame within the confines of the Dangai.

Extensive research into the physiology of the Dangai can allow an individual to gain space/time manipulation abilities, as represented by Kagerōza Inaba, the 7th Seat of the 12th Division.

entries.name: Kōtotsu
entries.content: The Kōtotsu (Wresting-Surge), is the Dangai's equivalent to a street sweeper. The Kōtotsu appears once every seven days to cleanse the area - killing anyone and everything that makes contact with it - to assure that no one can loiter and take advantage of the time distortion. It looks like the same material that makes up the Precipice World, only molded into the shape of a bullet train, and a golden eye at the upper-center of its body. If the Kōtotsu touches a Zanpakutō or other spiritual weapon, the user and weapon are trapped, since the Kōtotsu's body is flowing with the Kōryū current. The Soul Society has no means of sealing the Kōtotsu. If a being is caught by the Kōtotsu, they'll be thrown out to a greatly different point in time from when they entered the Precipice World. If one is powerful enough a Kōtotsu can be destroyed.

entries.name: Kenpachi
entries.content: Kenpachi (Sword-Eight) is the title that is only given to the strongest Shinigami. It is an ironclad rule that there can be only one Kenpachi per generation, meaning that the predecessor must die for the killer to succeed the title. To inherit this title, the candidate must kill the current Kenpachi in battle.

entries.name: Konsō Reisai
entries.content: Konsō Reisai (Soul Burial Ceremony Ritual) is a unique, ceremonial version of Konsō performed twelve years after the funeral rites of Gotei 13 captains who perished in battle, where the current captains and lieutenants capture a Hollow and purify it in front of the grave of the deceased captain. Due to the Reishi comprising captains' bodies being too dense with Reiatsu, placing them in the upper three tiers of Spirit Class (Reii), it cannot naturally break down and be reabsorbed by the soil of Soul Society without intervention, with the ceremony supposedly being used to manually enact this phenomenon. However, the truth is that such potent Reishi can never be reabsorbed by Soul Society, and since allowing overly powerful Reishi to linger in Soul Society indefinitely poses a great risk, the true purpose of the ceremony is to cast deceased captains into Hell. Moreover, the format of the ceremony is notably flexible; though the standard practice consists of purifying a normal Hollow in front of a captain's grave in Soul Society, Jūshirō Ukitake was successfully cast into Hell after his death when Ichigo Kurosaki and the lieutenants slaughtered several Jigoku no Gaki in the Human World while Ichigo was carrying his Substitute Shinigami Badge, therefore allowing Ukitake to witness it.

entries.name: Jogimen Reibaku
entries.content: Before the Konsō Reisai can take place, the current lieutenants of the Gotei 13 are tasked with performing the Jogimen Reibaku (Prefacing Ceremonial Surface of Spiritual Arrest), where they assemble in the Human World and capture the Hollow that is to be purified later.

entries.name: Ryoka
entries.content: Ryoka (Traveling Evil(s)) is the term the Gotei 13 use to identify those who are not aligned with Soul Society, either allies, rebels, intruders, deserters, or invaders.

entries.name: Sekkiseki
entries.content: Sekkiseki (Spirit Reducing Stone) is a special mineral with properties that allow it to repel all Reiryoku. Sekkiseki is rare even within Soul Society and cannot be found naturally in large quantities; the majority of it comprises the wall that surrounds Seireitei, known as the Seireiheki (Pure Soul Wall).

entries.name: Seireiheki
entries.content: Sekkiseki is rare even within Soul Society and cannot be found naturally in large quantities; the majority of it comprises the wall that surrounds Seireitei, known as the Seireiheki (Pure Soul Wall).

entries.name: Shakonmaku
entries.content: Sekkiseki projects a unique wave of spiritual energy from its cut surfaces, enveloping the city with a spherical barrier called the Shakonmaku (Soul Shield Membrane). Because of the stone’s properties, any Reishi that passes through the barrier is instantly vaporized. However, it is possible for Reishi of sufficient density to pass through, albeit with difficulty. The Shakonmaku is even capable of preventing direct transportation into and out of Seireitei.

entries.name: Shin'eiyaku
entries.content: Pills designed by Kisuke Urahara to help Shinigami who have lost their Bankai to Quincy Medallions. By temporarily causing the user of a Bankai to Hollowfy, it effectively makes the Bankai "poison" for a Quincy due to their inability to take in Hollow Reiatsu without their souls being destroyed in the process. The Bankai then gradually returns to the Shinigami owner, with an additional effect of the Shinigami being Hollowfied temporarily.

entries.name: Beyond Bankai
entries.content: A concept from alternate-universe versions of the Gotei 13 captains who have attained a power beyond Bankai, effectively fusing themselves with their own Zanpakutō in the process and dramatically altering their physical appearances in ways corresponding to their unique abilities.

entries.name: Zanpakutō Type
entries.content: There are several types of Zanpakutō, though only three types have been mentioned (Melee, Kidō and Elemental). Kidō has many sub-groups, and the Elemental group, while part of Kidō-type grouping, is large and diverse enough to stand as its own grouping.

entries.name: Power Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are typically designed for various forms of armed melee combat rather than Kidō-based abilities.

entries.name: Kidō Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed around a special ability rather than close range combat potential.

entries.name: Kidō Sub Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Certain Zanpakutō possess defined abilities and exist in their own category. Due to them being designed around a special ability they are therefore a form of Kidō-Type Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Projectile Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that when released separate into one or more projectiles that the owner can control freely.

entries.name: Poison Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to generate and administer poison as a form of attack.

entries.name: Illusion Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed around the ability to generate and manipulate perceptions via illusions.

entries.name: Living Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed around the ability to generate living creatures that obey the wielder.

entries.name: Elemental Sub Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: A large amount of the Zanpakutō are classified by elements, generally utilizing their respective elements as forms of attack. Elemental Zanpakutō are all Kidō-sub-type which have an element basis.

entries.name: Fire Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to generate fire and manipulate fire for various forms of attack or defense.

entries.name: Ice Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to generate water and manipulate it into ice (and related effects) for various forms of attack or defense.

entries.name: Earth Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to manipulate the ground for various forms of attack or defense.

entries.name: Wind-Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to manipulate wind for various forms of attack or defense.

entries.name: Water Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to generate and manipulate water (and related effects) for various forms of attack or defense.

entries.name: Lightning Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to generate and manipulate lightning for various forms of effects.

entries.name: Darkness Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to generate and manipulate darkness for various forms of effects.

entries.name: Unknown Zanpakutō Type
entries.content: These are Zanpakutō which cannot have their type readily verified.

entries.name: Defense Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed around defensive capability with little or no offense.

entries.name: Plant Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to generate and manipulate plant(s) for various forms of attack or defense.

entries.name: Light Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to generate and manipulate light for various forms of effects.

entries.name: Reality Type Zanpakutō
entries.content: Zanpakutō that are designed to control and influence various fundamental forces, physics, and aspects of the universe like Time, Gravity, Space and so on.

entries.name: Noble Houses
entries.content: The Noble Houses of Soul Society have an unclear role in the culture, social and governmental aspects of that dimensions existence. The Four Noble Families carry the most weight and appear to have some influence over the governmental institutions (i.e. Central 46 Chambers) and even institutions outside of the government (i.e. Shin'ō Academy). The military (i.e. Gotei 13, Kidō Corps & Onmitsukidō) have no authority to act against a noble family without evidence that their actions are treasonous to Soul Society.

entries.name: Shihōin
entries.content:
The Shihōin Clan / Shihōin family is one of the Four Great Noble families of Soul Society. By tradition, the head of the Shihōin family leads the Onmitsukidō. Also known as the Tenshiheisōban (Guard of the Heavenly Granted Armaments), they are the Caretakers of the Hōgu (Treasured Tools) and Bugu (Armaments) said to have been bestowed on them by the gods.

Every generation the head of the Shihōin is tasked to protect the Tenshiheisō ( Imperial Soldier Garments), an incredible spiritual tool that is said to have been handed down from the Heavens. If they attain a captain seat in the Gotei 13, the Onmitsukidō are led under that captaincy as well.

entries.name: Kuchiki
entries.content: The Kuchiki Clan / Kuchiki family is one of the Four Great Noble families of Soul Society and is considered the "Shōichī" (First Hierarchical Rank) among them. By tradition, the family has been charged with compiling and protecting the history of Soul Society. The head of the clan is served by a contingent of ninjas, clad in purple jumpsuits and light purple vests with golden headbands inscribed with kanji, that operate as the main security force of the Kuchiki Manor.

entries.name: Tsunayashiro
entries.content:
The Tsunayashiro Clan / Tsunayashiro family is one of the Four Great Noble families of Soul Society. The Tsunayashiro Clan is commonly believed to be the most powerful and influential of the Four Great Noble families of Soul Society. This is primarily due to their strong "survival of the fittest" mentality, and their dedication to culling the "weak" from their own lineage. Despite their lust for power, no clan member before Tokinada would dare wield the heirloom Zanpakutō, Enrakyōten, due to the curse that comes with the sword.

The Tsunayashiro Clan's primary responsibilities in Soul Society is to manage the Visuals Department surveillance, to make sure all history is recorded

entries.name: Fēng
entries.content: The Fēng Clan / Fēng Family is a lower noble family. Traditionally serves the Shihōin Clan by joining the Onmitsukidō. The Fēng Family makes its living as assassins and executioners. Any member who doesn't pass the test to get into the Onmitsukidō's Executive Militia is exiled.

entries.name: Kyōraku
entries.content: The Kyōraku Clan / Kyōraku Family is is an old, prestigious and somewhat high-ranking noble family.

entries.name: Ukitake
entries.content: The Ukitake Clan / Ukitake Family is a low-class aristocratic noble family.

entries.name: Ōmaeda
entries.content: The Ōmaeda Clan / Ōmaeda Family is an aristocratic, rich family. The family has a history of service in the Onmitsukidō.

entries.name: Kira
entries.content: The Kira Clan / Kira Family is a lesser noble family.

entries.name: Former Noble Houses
entries.content: The Shiba Clan: The family was once the fifth great noble family, having prestige along the lines of the Kuchiki and Shihōin families. For an unknown reason, the Shiba family fell from their high status position after the death of Lieutenant Kaien Shiba. The family specializes in fireworks.

entries.name: Ise
entries.content:
While not exactly noble, these families are notable for being highly respected and revered within Soul Society.

The Ise Clan / Ise family is a clan of Shinto Priests from Soul Society.

entries.name: Kasumiōji Clan
entries.content:
The Kasumiōji Clan is a high-ranking noble family that is just below the four great noble families in status, with Yoruichi Shihōin commenting that their circumstances are a bit "special." The Kasumiōji family members are well known as master forgers in the art of weapons crafting, making the finest weapons in all of Soul Society. The family is traditionally lead by a female.

The Kannogi Family is another high-ranking noble family. They are connected to and often affiliated with the Kasumiōji Family.

entries.name: Bambies
entries.content:
The Bambies are a group of five Quincy women and members of the Wandenreich's Sternritter who typically hangout and spend time with each other. The group is able to operate together even with the disappearance of its leader. The Members and their Schrifts are: 

Bambietta Basterbine, designated "E" - "The Explode"
Liltotto Lamperd, designated "G" - "The Glutton"
Meninas McAllon, designated "P" - "The Power"
Candice Catnipp, designated "T" - "The Thunderbolt"
Giselle Gewelle, designated "Z" - "The Zombie"

entries.name: Gatekeeper
entries.content: The Four Great Seireimon Gatekeepers are the guardians of Seireitei's gates. The gatekeepers are charged with protecting the Seireitei from intruders by ensuring that they do not pass through the Four Great Seireimon. All four gatekeepers are individuals of incredible size, and are considered elite members of Soul Society. Each one of them is assigned a specific gate to preside over.

entries.name: Tres Bestias
entries.content: The Tres Bestias (Three Beasts) are the three Arrancar that serve as Espada Tier Harribel's Fracción. The members include: Emilou Apacci, Franceska Mila Rose and Cyan Sung-Sun.

entries.name: Kidō Corps
entries.content:
The Kidō Corps is a separate branch of Soul Society's military that excels in the art of Kidō. The Kidō Corps is a group of specialists presiding over spiritual law. It is one of the organizations within Soul Society that is allowed the use of force along with the Gotei 13 and Onmitsukidō, and is also a special organization comprised of experienced Kidō users. Even the Gotei 13 put their trust in their skills.

The Kidō Corps takes students from the Shin'ō Academy that excel in Kidō and trains them to further their abilities in said area. Its operations are executed in absolute secrecy. During an incident one hundred years ago, Jūshirō Ukitake noted how rare it was to see anyone from the Kidō Corps, especially the captain. The Kidō Corps is responsible for opening the Senkaimon between the Human World and Soul Society. The Kidō Corps is responsible for releasing the Sōkyoku seal during executions.

entries.name: Wolfman Clan
entries.content: The Wolfman Clan is a clan of "sinful" Souls living in self-imposed exile within Soul Society's Rukongai region. The Wolfman Clan is a family of Souls who, during their lifetime, committed "sins" of unknown nature that caused them the punishment of being turned into "wolfmen" and fall into what is referred to as the Animal Realm / Hell of Beasts, the precise nature of which is unknown. Yet even such punishment supposedly did not suffice and the clan returned to Soul Society, to continue dwelling in the shadows of Rukongai to be free from outsiders' scrutiny.

entries.name: Humanization Technique
entries.content: The Humanization Technique  (Jinka no Jutsu or Humanification) is a secret ability of the Wolfman Clan that allows their kind to temporarily shed their Wolfman form and become a complete Human by ritually removing their heart as an offering. In their Human form, a clan member's body is nothing more than an empty shell, rendered immortal in exchange for their heart: as long as the transformation persists, no attacks made against them will have any lasting effect and wounds quickly regenerate. However, the transformation is only temporary and demands grave "compensation" (daishō): once their time has run out, the clan member in question will regress from a Human into a complete wolf permanently. This was seen with Sajin, who lost himself in his drive for revenge and promptly turned into a wolf, subsequently having his heart consumed by his elder.

entries.name: Keigo Asano
entries.content: Keigo Asano is a student at the Karakura High School, in the same class as Ichigo Kurosaki. Twelve years after Ichigo defeated Yhwach, Keigo opened up a Ramen shop. Is one of Ichigo's friends.

entries.name: Mizuho Asano
entries.content: Mizuho Asano is the older sister of Keigo Asano. She is the 24th Student Council President at Karakura 1st High School and handles multiple school affairs, including the local Kendo Club.

entries.name: Tatsuki Arisawa
entries.content: Tatsuki Arisawa (Arisawa Tatsuki) is a student at Karakura High School, and is in the same class as Ichigo Kurosaki, her childhood friend and former karate partner.

entries.name: Oscar Joaquín de la Rosa
entries.content: Oscar Joaquín De la Rosa was Yasutora Sado's grandfather. After the death of Chad's parents, he raised him in his native Mexico until his death.

entries.name: Jinta Hanakari
entries.content: Jinta Hanakari is one of the employees of the Urahara Shop.

entries.name: Chizuru Honshō
entries.content: Chizuru Honshō is a student at Karakura High School, in the same class as Ichigo Kurosaki. Her name is listed as the 31st student in academic achievements.

entries.name: Orihime Inoue
entries.content: Orihime Inoue is a Human living in Karakura Town. She is a student of Karakura High School. Is one of Ichigo's close friends.

entries.name: Kagine
entries.content: Kagine-sensei is a high school physical education teacher at Karakura High School.

entries.name: Don Kanonji
entries.content: Don Kanonji (real name Misaomaru Kanonji), is a popular spirit Mediumship who hosts a television show called Casual Soul Realm Assault Trip, often referred to simply as Cazh Soul.

entries.name: Mizuiro Kojima
entries.content: Mizuiro Kojima is a student in Karakura High School and is in the same class as Ichigo Kurosaki. Is one of Ichigo's friends.

entries.name: Ryō Kunieda
entries.content: Ryō Kunieda is a classmate of Ichigo Kurosaki at Karakura High School.

entries.name: Ichigo Kurosaki
entries.content: Ichigo Kurosaki is a Human who is also a Substitute Shinigami. Ichigo is the son of Isshin and Masaki Kurosaki, and older brother of Karin and Yuzu.

entries.name: Karin Kurosaki
entries.content: Karin Kurosaki is the fraternal younger twin sister of Yuzu, daughter of Isshin and Masaki Kurosaki, and youngest sister of Ichigo.

entries.name: Kazui Kurosaki
entries.content: Kazui Kurosaki is a human with Shinigami powers. He is the son of Ichigo Kurosaki and Orihime Inoue.

entries.name: Yuzu Kurosaki
entries.content: Yuzu Kurosaki is the fraternal older twin of Karin and the younger sister of Ichigo Kurosaki.

entries.name: Mahana Natsui
entries.content: Mahana Natsui is a friend of Orihime Inoue and Tatsuki Arisawa.

entries.name: Misato Ochi
entries.content: Misato Ochi is a teacher at Karakura High School. Her pupils include Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends.

entries.name: Michiru Ogawa
entries.content: Michiru Ogawa is a classmate of Ichigo Kurosaki and Orihime Inoue at Karakura High School.

entries.name: Jackie Tristan
entries.content: Jackie Tristan is a Human who formerly possessed Fullbring powers and is a former member of the organization known as Xcution.

entries.name: Ururu Tsumugiya
entries.content: Ururu Tsumugiya is an employee of the Urahara Shop.

entries.name: Ikumi Unagiya
entries.content: Ikumi Unagiya is the owner and manager of the Unagiya Shop in Karakura Town, a business which performs a variety of odd jobs for its customers. She hires Ichigo Kurosaki sometime after the loss of his Shinigami powers.

entries.name: Kaoru Unagiya
entries.content: Kaoru Unagiya is the young son of Ikumi Unagiya, Ichigo Kurosaki's employer.

entries.name: Riruka Dokugamine
entries.content: Riruka Dokugamine is a Fullbringer and formerly member No. 003 of the organization known as Xcution.

entries.name: Kūgo Ginjō
entries.content: Kūgo Ginjō is a Fullbringer and was the leader and member No. 001 of the organization known as Xcution. He is also a former Substitute Shinigami.

entries.name: Giriko Kutsuzawa
entries.content: Giriko Kutsuzawa is a Fullbringer and a member of Xcution.

entries.name: Yasutora Sado
entries.content: Yasutora Sado, also known as Chad, is a Human and Fullbringer living in Karakura Town. He's one of Ichigo's close friends and classmates.

entries.name: Moe Shishigawara
entries.content: Moe Shishigawara  is a high school student from Miyashita Commercial High School. He is also a Fullbringer who once worked under Shūkurō Tsukishima.

entries.name: Shūkurō Tsukishima
entries.content: Shūkurō Tsukishima is a Fullbringer and a former member of Xcution.

entries.name: Yukio Hans Vorarlberna
entries.content: Yukio Hans Vorarlberna is a Fullbringer and formerly member No. 005 of the organization known as Xcution. He is also the president of his family's company, Y. Hans Enterprise.

entries.name: Aura Michibane
entries.content: Aura Michibane is a Fullbringer who formed and led the "XCUTION Religious Organization", a cult in the Human World that knows about the existence of Soul Society. She is also the host of the Saketsu (Binding Chain) of the Soul King. After her death as a Human, she resides as a Soul in Hueco Mundo alongside the Arrancar there.

entries.name: Ichika Abarai
entries.content: Ichika Abarai is a Shinigami apprentice in the Gotei 13. She is the daughter of Rukia Kuchiki and Renji Abarai.

entries.name: Renji Abarai
entries.content: Renji Abarai is the lieutenant of the 6th Division under Captain Byakuya Kuchiki.

entries.name: Sōsuke Aizen
entries.content: Sōsuke Aizen is the former captain of the 5th Division in the Gotei 13. He later leaves Soul Society with his followers, Gin Ichimaru and Kaname Tōsen. His lieutenant was Momo Hinamori. He formerly served as the lieutenant of the 5th Division under Shinji Hirako. After waging war against Soul Society with an army of Arrancar, Aizen was defeated by Ichigo Kurosaki and sealed away by Kisuke Urahara, and then imprisoned for his crimes. He is fused with the Hōgyoku.

entries.name: Akon
entries.content: Akon is the lieutenant and former 3rd Seat of the 12th Division, and Vice-President of the Shinigami Research and Development Institute.

entries.name: Makizō Aramaki
entries.content: Makizō Aramaki (nicknamed Maki-Maki) is a Shinigami and a member of the 11th Division.

entries.name: Yumichika Ayasegawa
entries.content: Yumichika Ayasegawa is the 3rd Seat officer and former 5th Seat officer in the 11th Division of the Gotei 13, under Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

entries.name: Shinobu Eishima
entries.content: Shinobu Eishima was the 4th Seat of the 9th Division in the Gotei 13 who served under Captain Kensei Muguruma.

entries.name: Tatsufusa Enjōji
entries.content: Tatsufusa Enjōji is the 3rd Seat of the Eighth Division.

entries.name: Kirio Hikifune
entries.content: Kirio Hikifune is a former captain of the 12th Division and a member of the Royal Guard, holding the title "Ruler of Grain". She holds the position of Second Officer of the Zero Division, as well as "Divine General of the South"

entries.name: Momo Hinamori
entries.content: Momo Hinamori is the lieutenant of the 5th Division, formerly under Captain Sōsuke Aizen and currently under Captain Shinji Hirako.

entries.name: Shūhei Hisagi
entries.content: Shūhei Hisagi is the co-lieutenant of the 9th Division, formerly under Captain Kaname Tōsen and currently under Captain Kensei Muguruma. He shares his position with Mashiro Kuna.

entries.name: Tōshirō Hitsugaya
entries.content: Tōshirō Hitsugaya is the captain of the 10th Division in the Gotei 13. His lieutenant is Rangiku Matsumoto. He formerly served as the 3rd Seat of the 10th Division under Isshin Shiba.

entries.name: Hiyosu
entries.content: Hiyosu is a department head in the Shinigami Research and Development Institute, which is tied to the 12th Division.

entries.name: Ichibē Hyōsube
entries.content: Ichibē Hyōsube is the Leader of the Zero Division holding the title "Monk Who Calls the Real Name".

entries.name: Chikane Iba
entries.content: Chikane Iba is the former lieutenant of the 3rd Division while Rōjūrō Ōtoribashi was the captain over 100 years ago. She is the mother of Tetsuzaemon Iba.

entries.name: Tetsuzaemon Iba
entries.content: Tetsuzaemon Iba is the captain of the 7th Division of the Gotei 13. His lieutenant is Atau Rindō. He was formerly the 7th Division's lieutenant under Captain Sajin Komamura.

entries.name: Gin Ichimaru
entries.content: Gin Ichimaru was the captain of the 3rd Division of the Gotei 13 until he betrayed Soul Society, alongside Sōsuke Aizen and Kaname Tōsen. His lieutenant was Izuru Kira. He formerly served as the lieutenant of the 5th Division under Sōsuke Aizen and the 3rd Seat of the 5th Division under Shinji Hirako.

entries.name: Yasochika Iemura
entries.content: Yasochika Iemura is the co-3rd Seat officer of the 4th Division along with Hanatarō Yamada, and the leader of the first relief team formerly serving under Captain Retsu Unohana and currently under Captain Isane Kotetsu. He is also the Vice-President of the Shinigami Men's Association.

entries.name: Jirōbō Ikkanzaka
entries.content: Jirōbō Ikkanzaka is the former 4th Seat of the Seventh Division and the younger brother of Jidanbō Ikkanzaka. He is also known by the nickname Kamaitachi (Sickle Weasel).

entries.name: Shinigami Men's Association
entries.content: The Shinigami Men's Association is a men's club of Shinigami that sees themselves both as a men's meeting facility and the rival towards the Shinigami Women's Association.

entries.name: Nanao Ise
entries.content: Nanao Ise is the co-lieutenant of the First Division of the Gotei 13, under her uncle, Captain Shunsui Kyōraku, and Vice-President of the Shinigami Women's Association. She has also formerly served as Lieutenant of the Eighth Division.

entries.name: Kinroku Izuhara
entries.content: Kinroku Izuhara was the first captain of the 3rd Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Hidetomo Kajōmaru
entries.content: Hidetomo Kajōmaru was the 6th Seat of the 13th Division in the Gotei 13, under Captain Jūshirō Ukitake.

entries.name: Kakyō
entries.content: Kakyō was a Shinigami and a close friend of Kaname Tōsen until her murder, which was the catalyst that proceeded to turn Tōsen against Soul Society.

entries.name: Batsu'unsai Katori
entries.content: Batsu'unsai Katori was the first captain of the 8th Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Kenpachi Kiganjō
entries.content: Kenpachi Kiganjō was the 10th Kenpachi. A century ago, he was the captain of the 11th Division and the predecessor of Kenpachi Zaraki. Prior to becoming the Kenpachi, Kiganjō's name was Gosuke Kiganjō.

entries.name: Izuru Kira
entries.content: Izuru Kira is the lieutenant of the 3rd Division in the Gotei 13, formerly under Captain Gin Ichimaru and currently under Captain Rōjūrō Ōtoribashi.

entries.name: Tenjirō Kirinji
entries.content: Tenjirō Kirinji is a member of the Royal Guard, holding the title "Hot Spring Demon". He holds the position of First Officer of the Zero Division, as well as "Divine General of the East".

entries.name: Sajin Komamura
entries.content: Sajin Komamura is the former captain of the 7th Division. His lieutenant was Tetsuzaemon Iba.

entries.name: Isane Kotetsu
entries.content: Isane Kotetsu is the Captain of the 4th Division and former lieutenant under Captain Retsu Unohana. Her lieutenant is her younger sister, Kiyone Kotetsu, the former 13th Division's 3rd Seat.

entries.name: Kiyone Kotetsu
entries.content: Kiyone Kotetsu is the lieutenant of the Fourth Division under her sister Isane Kotetsu. She is also the former co-3rd Seat officer of the Thirteenth Division in the Gotei 13 under Captain Jūshirō Ukitake. She shared her previous position with Sentarō Kotsubaki.

entries.name: Jinemon Kotsubaki
entries.content: Jinemon Kotsubaki was the former lieutenant of the 7th Division while Love Aikawa was the captain over 100 years ago. He is the father of Sentarō Kotsubaki.

entries.name: Sentarō Kotsubaki
entries.content: Sentarō Kotsubaki is the Lieutenant of the Thirteenth Division of the Gotei 13 currently under Rukia Kuchiki, and formerly under Jūshirō Ukitake. He used to share the position of 3rd Seat with Kiyone Kotetsu.

entries.name: Byakuya Kuchiki
entries.content: Byakuya Kuchiki is the 28th head of the Kuchiki Clan, one of the four great noble clans in Soul Society. He is also the captain of the 6th Division in the Gotei 13. His previous lieutenant was Ginjirō Shirogane and his current lieutenant is Renji Abarai.

entries.name: Ginrei Kuchiki
entries.content: Ginrei Kuchiki is Byakuya Kuchiki's grandfather. Over 100 years ago, he was the captain of the 6th Division and the 27th Head of the Kuchiki Clan until being succeeded by Byakuya in both positions. His lieutenant was his son, Sōjun Kuchiki.

entries.name: Rukia Kuchiki
entries.content: Rukia Kuchiki is the current captain of the 13th Division. She formerly served as lieutenant of the 13th Division under Captain Jūshirō Ukitake. Rukia is the adoptive sister of Byakuya Kuchiki, a friend of Ichigo Kurosaki, and is married to Renji Abarai.

entries.name: Sōjun Kuchiki
entries.content: Sōjun Kuchiki is the former lieutenant of the 6th Division, having held the position when Ginrei Kuchiki captained over 100 years ago. In addition, he is the father of Byakuya Kuchiki.

entries.name: Entetsu Kumoi
entries.content: Entetsu Kumoi was the first captain of the 9th Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Niko Kuna
entries.content: Niko Kuna is a veteran researcher who works for the S.R.D.I., which is tied to the 12th Division of the Gotei 13.

entries.name: Isshin Kurosaki
entries.content: Isshin Kurosaki, formerly known as Isshin Shiba, is the former captain of the 10th Division, husband of Masaki Kurosaki, and father of Ichigo Kurosaki, Karin Kurosaki, and Yuzu Kurosaki. Isshin is the former head of a branch of the Shiba Clan and the current head of the Kurosaki Family.

entries.name: Mayuri Kurotsuchi
entries.content: Mayuri Kurotsuchi is the captain of the 12th Division in the Gotei 13 and 2nd president of the Shinigami Research Institute. His previous lieutenant was Nemu Kurotsuchi, his artificially-created "daughter", and his current lieutenant is Akon. He formerly served as the 3rd Seat of the 12th Division under Kisuke Urahara.

entries.name: Nemu Kurotsuchi
entries.content: Nemu Kurotsuchi, formerly known as Nanagō Nemuri (Sleeping Number 7), was the former lieutenant of the 12th Division of the Gotei 13, serving under Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

entries.name: Zennosuke Kurumadani
entries.content: Zennosuke Kurumadani, sometimes referred to as either "Afro-san" or "Af-san" due to his large Afro, is the Shinigami who replaces Rukia Kuchiki as the guardian of the areas around Karakura Town. He is a member of the Thirteenth Division.

entries.name: Yachiru Kusajishi
entries.content: Yachiru Kusajishi s the former lieutenant of the 11th Division in the Gotei 13, under Captain Kenpachi Zaraki, as well as the former President of the Shinigami Women's Association.

entries.name: Shunsui Kyōraku
entries.content: Shunsui Sakuranosuke Jirō Kyōraku is the captain of the 1st Division and Captain-Commander of the Gotei 13. His lieutenants are his niece, Nanao Ise, and Genshirō Okikiba. He is the former captain of the 8th Division.

entries.name: Ikkaku Madarame
entries.content: Ikkaku Madarame is the lieutenant and former 3rd Seat officer in the 11th Division of the Gotei 13, under Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

entries.name: Shino Madarame
entries.content: Shino Madarame is one of the Shinigami that replaces Zennosuke Kurumadani as the guardian of the Karakura Town area.

entries.name: Rangiku Matsumoto
entries.content: Rangiku Matsumoto is the lieutenant of the 10th Division of the Gotei 13, serving under Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya.

entries.name: Ōetsu Nimaiya
entries.content: Ōetsu Nimaiya is a member of the Royal Guard, holding the title "God of the Sword". He holds the position of Third Officer of the Zero Division, as well as "Divine General of the West".

entries.name: Danjirō Obana
entries.content: Danjirō Obana was the first captain of the 5th Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Harunobu Ogidō
entries.content: Harunobu Ogidō is the 8th Seat of the Fourth Division as well as the second leader of the first relief team.

entries.name: Genshirō Okikiba
entries.content: Genshirō Okikiba was formerly the 3rd Seat of the 1st Division in the Gotei 13 under Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto, and is currently the co-lieutenant of the 1st Division in the Gotei 13 under Captain-Commander Shunsui Kyōraku. He shares the position with Nanao Ise.

entries.name: Marechiyo Ōmaeda
entries.content: Marechiyo Yoshiayamenosuke Nikkōtarōemon Ōmaeda is the lieutenant of the Second Division, under Captain Suì-Fēng. He is also the Corps Commander of the Patrol Corps in the Onmitsukidō.

entries.name: Marenoshin Ōmaeda
entries.content: Marenoshin Ōmaeda is the former lieutenant of the 2nd Division while Yoruichi Shihōin was the captain 100 years ago. He is the father of Marechiyo Ōmaeda.

entries.name: Furuoki Ōtogawa
entries.content: Furuoki Ōtogawa was the first captain of the 10th Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Gengorō Ōnabara
entries.content: Gengorō Ōnabara is an instructor at the Shinigami's Shin'ō Academy.

entries.name: Atau Rindō
entries.content: Atau Rindō is the lieutenant of the 7th Division of the Gotei 13 under Captain Tetsuzaemon Iba.

entries.name: Furōfushi Saitō
entries.content: Furōfushi Saitō was the first captain of the 6th Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Saizō Sakahone
entries.content: Saizō Sakahone was the first captain of the 13th Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Chōjirō Sasakibe
entries.content: Chōjirō Tadaoki Sasakibe was the lieutenant of the 1st Division under the command of Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto. He had kept this post for at least 110 years.

entries.name: Kaien Shiba
entries.content: Kaien Shiba is the former lieutenant of the 13th Division, under Jūshirō Ukitake, up until his death at the hands of a Hollow that also killed his wife, Miyako Shiba. He was the older brother of Kūkaku and Ganju.

entries.name: Miyako Shiba
entries.content: Miyako Shiba was the former 3rd Seat of the 13th Division and served under Captain Jūshirō Ukitake. She is the wife of Kaien Shiba.

entries.name: Nobutsuna Shigyō
entries.content: Nobutsuna Shigyō (Shigyō Nobutsuna) was the first captain of the 7th Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Chika Shihōin
entries.content: Chika Shihōin was the first captain of the 2nd Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Yoruichi Shihōin
entries.content: Yoruichi Shihōin is the former captain of the 2nd Division of the Gotei 13, as well as the former commander of the Onmitsukidō. Her Lieutenant was Marenoshin Ōmaeda. Having abandoned her command of both positions, she works with Kisuke Urahara and Tessai Tsukabishi, based in the Urahara Shop out in the Human World.

entries.name: Chigiri Shijima
entries.content: Chigiri Shijima was the first captain of the 4th Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Senjumaru Shutara
entries.content: Senjumaru Shutara is a member of the Royal Guard, holding the title "Great Weave Guard". She holds the position of Fourth Officer of the Zero Division, as well as "Divine General of the North".

entries.name: Suì-Fēng
entries.content: Suì-Fēng (Soifon) is the commander-in-chief of the Onmitsukidō and the captain of the 2nd Division in the Gotei 13. Her lieutenant is Marechiyo Ōmaeda.

entries.name: Kōkichirō Takezoe
entries.content: Kōkichirō Takezoe is the 7th Seat in the 10th Division under Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya.

entries.name: Rin Tsubokura
entries.content: Rin Tsubokura is a Shinigami and a researcher of the Shinigami Research and Development Institute.

entries.name: Tessai Tsukabishi
entries.content: Tessai Tsukabishi is an employee of Urahara Shop and a childhood friend of Kisuke Urahara and Yoruichi Shihōin. One hundred years ago, he was the Captain of the Kidō Corps in Soul Society. He was forced into exile by Sōsuke Aizen and is currently hiding in the Human World with Urahara in an untraceable Gigai while helping out in his shop.

entries.name: Jūshirō Ukitake
entries.content: Jūshirō Ukitake was the captain of the 13th Division in the Gotei 13. At one point in time, his lieutenant was Kaien Shiba, and later was Rukia Kuchiki. For most of his life, he hosted Mimihagi, the Right Arm of the Soul King, in his body. After being cast into Hell, Ukitake gains the epithet of "Kamikake" (Divine Possession).

entries.name: Toshimori Umesada
entries.content: Toshimori Umesada is the 20th Seat of the 9th Division (a position he shares with 15 other Shinigami.

entries.name: Retsu Unohana
entries.content: Retsu Unohana, formerly known as Yachiru Unohana, was the former captain of the Fourth Division in the Gotei 13. She was one of the oldest and most experienced captains, and was Soul Society's best healer. Her lieutenant was Isane Kotetsu. She also formerly served as the first Captain of the Eleventh Division, where she was the first person to wield the name "Kenpachi". After she was cast into Hell, Unohana gained the epithet of "Death Sword" (Shiken).

entries.name: Kisuke Urahara
entries.content: Kisuke Urahara is the former captain of the 12th Division, as well as the founder and 1st President of the S.R.D.I.. His lieutenant was Hiyori Sarugaki. He lives in the Human World where he owns a small convenience store which sells Shinigami items. He is assisted by his employees Tessai Tsukabishi, Jinta Hanakari, and Ururu Tsumugiya.

entries.name: Hanatarō Yamada
entries.content: Hanatarō Yamada is the co-3rd Seat and former 7th Seat of the 4th Division in the Gotei 13, serving as the leader of the 14th Advanced Relief Team.

entries.name: Seinosuke Yamada
entries.content: Seinosuke Yamada was the lieutenant of the 4th Division, the medical and supply relief division, in Gotei 13 under Captain Retsu Unohana.

entries.name: Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto
entries.content: Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto was the captain of the 1st Division in the Gotei 13 and also the Captain-Commander of the whole Gotei 13. His lieutenant was Chōjirō Sasakibe. After being cast into Hell, he has gained the epithet of "Founder of the Gotei".

entries.name: Yuyu Yayahara
entries.content: Yuyu Yayahara is the lieutenant of the 8th Division of the Gotei 13 under Captain Lisa Yadōmaru.

entries.name: Rikichi Yuki
entries.content: Rikichi Yuki is an unseated officer of the 6th Division.

entries.name: Ryūnosuke Yuki
entries.content: Ryūnosuke Yuki is one of the Shinigami that replaces Zennosuke Kurumadani as the guardian of the Karakura Town area.

entries.name: Kenpachi Zaraki
entries.content: Kenpachi Zaraki is the current captain of the 11th Division in the Gotei 13. He is the eleventh Kenpachi to hold the position. His first lieutenant was Yachiru Kusajishi and his current lieutenant is Ikkaku Madarame.

entries.name: Uhin Zenjōji
entries.content: Uhin Zenjōji was the first captain of the 12th Division over 1,000 years ago.

entries.name: Love Aikawa
entries.content: Rabu Aikawa, more commonly referred to as Love, is a Visored and the former captain of the 7th Division. His lieutenant was Jinemon Kotsubaki.

entries.name: Shinji Hirako
entries.content: Shinji Hirako is the captain of the 5th Division in the Gotei 13. His lieutenant is Momo Hinamori. He also served as a recruiter and the de facto leader of the Visored. He was also a captain over 100 years ago prior to his exile and was reinstated to his old post sometime after the battle against Sōsuke Aizen.

entries.name: Mashiro Kuna
entries.content: Mashiro Kuna is the co-lieutenant of the 9th Division, currently under Kensei Muguruma and is currently a member of the Visored.

entries.name: Kensei Muguruma
entries.content: Kensei Muguruma is the captain of the 9th Division in the Gotei 13. His lieutenants are Shūhei Hisagi and Mashiro Kuna. He is a Visored. He was also a captain over 100 years ago prior to his exile, and was reinstated to his old post some time after the battle against Sōsuke Aizen.

entries.name: Rōjūrō Ōtoribashi
entries.content: Rōjūrō Ōtoribashi, is the captain of the 3rd Division in the Gotei 13 and a Visored. His lieutenant is Izuru Kira. He was also a Captain over 100 years ago prior to his exile, and was reinstated to his old post some time after the battle against Sōsuke Aizen.

entries.name: Hiyori Sarugaki
entries.content: Hiyori Sarugaki is the former lieutenant of the 12th Division under Captains Kirio Hikifune and Kisuke Urahara, and currently a Visored.

entries.name: Hachigen Ushōda
entries.content: Hachigen Ushōda is a Visored, formerly the lieutenant of the Kidō Corps under Tessai Tsukabishi. He is usually referred to as Hacchi.

entries.name: Lisa Yadōmaru
entries.content: Lisa Yadōmaru is a Visored and the current captain of the 8th Division. Her Lieutenant is Yuyu Yayahara. She is the former lieutenant of the 8th Division under Captain Shunsui Kyōraku.

entries.name: Kaname Tōsen
entries.content: Kaname Tōsen was the captain of the 9th Division of the Gotei 13 until he betrayed Soul Society, alongside Sōsuke Aizen and Gin Ichimaru. This betrayal put him at odds with his former best friend Sajin Komamura, as well as his former lieutenant in the 9th Division, Shūhei Hisagi. He formerly served as the 5th Seat of the 9th Division under Kensei Muguruma.

entries.name: Sōya Azashiro
entries.content: Sōya Azashiro, otherwise known as Kenpachi Azashiro, was once a captain of the 11th Division in the Gotei 13. He was the 8th Kenpachi, having won the title from his predecessor, Kenpachi Kuruyashiki. He was a member of the prominent Azashiro Family.

entries.name: Kenpachi Kuruyashiki
entries.content: Kenpachi Kuruyashiki was once a captain of the 11th Division in the Gotei 13. He was the 7th Kenpachi, until he was killed by his successor, Sōya Azashiro.

entries.name: Loly Aivirrne
entries.content: Loly Aivirrne is the 33rd Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army. She and Menoly Mallia served as Aizen's aides.

entries.name: Luppi Antenor
entries.content: Luppi Antenor was the Sexta (6th) Espada in Sōsuke Aizen's army, having temporarily replaced Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez before his death at the latter's hands. He was later resurrected by Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

entries.name: Emilou Apacci
entries.content: Emilou Apacci is the 54th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Tier Harribel's three Fracción, collectively known as the Tres Bestias. She is a tomboyish Arrancar with heterochromia, one sky blue and one amber eye, with the latter having a blue ring around it. Apacci's mask fragment is on the top of her head, with a horn in the middle. Apacci's Zanpakutō consists of the bracelets strapped to her arms.

entries.name: Franceska Mila Rose
entries.content: Franceska Mila Rose is the 55th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Tier Harribel's three Fracción, collectively known as the Tres Bestias. She is a dark-skinned Arrancar whose mask fragments form a three-sectioned crown around her head and a thick necklace. Her Hollow hole is positioned midway between her navel and breasts. Her Zanpakutō is a western style longsword.

entries.name: Aaroniero Arruruerie
entries.content: Aaroniero Arruruerie is an Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and the Noveno (9th) Espada.

entries.name: Dondochakka Birstanne
entries.content: Dondochakka Birstanne is a damaged Arrancar, and is one of Nel Tu's "brothers" and protectors.

entries.name: Findorr Calius
entries.content: Findorr Calius is the 24th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Baraggan Louisenbairn's six Fracción.

entries.name: Rudbornn Chelute
entries.content: Rudbornn Chelute is the 61st Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army, and the sole member and founder of the Exequias.

entries.name: Exequias
entries.content: A group of Arrancar that  clean up after each battle in Hueco Mundo, collecting data before killing any survivors. Rudbornn Chelute is the founder and every other member is a clone of him that he makes himself.

entries.name: Charlotte Chuhlhourne
entries.content: Charlotte Chuhlhourne was the 20th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Baraggan Louisenbairn's six Fracción prior to being killed by Yumichika Ayasegawa and later resurrected by Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

entries.name: Ulquiorra Cifer
entries.content: Ulquiorra Cifer is the Cuatro (4th) Espada in Aizen's army of Arrancar.

entries.name: Dordoni Alessandro Del Socaccio
entries.content: Dordoni Alessandro Del Socaccio was Arrancar Cientecimo Tercero (103rd) in Sōsuke Aizen's army prior to being killed by Rudbornn Chelute and later resurrected by Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

entries.name: Asguiaro Ebern
entries.content: Asguiaro Ebern is an Arrancar soldier in service to the Wandenreich.

entries.name: Luders Friegen
entries.content: Luders Friegen is an Arrancar soldier in service to the Wandenreich.

entries.name: Nnoitra Gilga
entries.content: Nnoitra Gilga is an Arrancar and the Quinto (5th) Espada in Sōsuke Aizen's army.

entries.name: Lilynette Gingerbuck
entries.content: Lilynette Gingerbuck is an Arrancar and Coyote Starrk's sole Fracción, as well as a part of the same Hollow entity: when he uses his Resurrección, the two become one.

entries.name: Szayelaporro Granz
entries.content: Szayelaporro Granz was an Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and the Octava (8th) Espada. He is the younger brother of Yylfordt Granz. After being killed by Mayuri Kurotsuchi, Szayelaporro was dragged down to Hell where he became a Jailer of Hell.

entries.name: Yylfordt Granz
entries.content: Yylfordt Granz is Arrancar Quince in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez's five Fracción. He is the older brother of Szayelaporro Granz, the 8th Espada.

entries.name: Nakeem Grindina
entries.content: Nakeem Grindina is Arrancar number Catorce (14) in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez's five Fracción.

entries.name: Pesche Guatiche
entries.content: Pesche Guatiche is a damaged Arrancar and is one of Nel Tu's "brothers" and protectors.

entries.name: Tier Harribel
entries.content: Tier Harribel is an Arrancar and the former Tres (3rd) Espada in Sōsuke Aizen's army until the latter's defeat. Sometime after Aizen's defeat, she becomes the de facto ruler of Hueco Mundo.

entries.name: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez
entries.content: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez is an Arrancar and was the Sexta (6th) Espada in Sōsuke Aizen's affiliated army.

entries.name: Shawlong Koufang
entries.content: Shawlong Koufang is the Undécimo (11th) Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army. He was a member, and apparently the leader, of Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez's five Fracción. His position as the 11th Arrancar before his death implies that he was the oldest living Números.

entries.name: Kukkapūro
entries.content: Kukkapūro is a Números in Sōsuke Aizen's army, holding the number 35, and was a companion of Yammy Llargo.

entries.name: Tesra Lindocruz
entries.content: Tesra Lindocruz is the 50th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and Nnoitra Gilga's only Fracción.

entries.name: Edrad Liones
entries.content: Edrad Liones is Arrancar number Trece (13) in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez's five Fracción.

entries.name: Yammy Llargo
entries.content: Yammy Llargo is an Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army. He holds the rank of Arrancar Diez (10), but becomes the Cero (0) Espada after releasing his Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Baraggan Louisenbairn
entries.content: Baraggan Louisenbairn is an Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and the Segunda (2nd) Espada. Prior to this, Baraggan ruled Las Noches as the God-King of Hueco Mundo.

entries.name: Lumina and Verona
entries.content: Lumina and Verona are two of Szayelaporro Granz's Fracción.

entries.name: Gantenbainne Mosqueda
entries.content: Gantenbainne Mosqueda is the 107th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army.

entries.name: Menoly Mallia
entries.content: Menoly Mallia is the 34th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army. She and Loly Aivirrne served as Aizen's aides.

entries.name: Wonderweiss Margela
entries.content: Wonderweiss Margela is the 77th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and the only modified Arrancar under Aizen's command. Though not an Espada, the Soul Society ranks his Spiritual Energy in the same class as theirs.

entries.name: Medazeppi
entries.content: Medazeppi was one of Szayelaporro Granz's Fracción and an Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army.

entries.name: Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck
entries.content:
Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck is an Arrancar and the former Tres (three) Espada. She was also known as Nel Tu when she was small, good-natured, and childlike. Nelliel lives in Hueco Mundo with her adoptive brothers and former Fracción, Dondochakka Birstanne and Pesche Guatiche, and their pet, Bawabawa.

Her true form is that of a tall, fully-grown curvaceous and well-endowed adult with long waving green hair. Notably, she has a scar and the crimson line that runs across her face, and pronounced lower canine teeth. Her gown is now torn into a skirt and a top, connected with a single strip across her abdomen. Her skull mask also differs slightly; its features appearing sharper and less cartoonish with a pair of curved horns, but still missing some of its teeth. A large "3" is tattooed on her back, indicating that she was the former 3rd Espada.

In her true adult form, she is much more mature, composed, logical, sophisticated, and intelligent than her child form. She is also relatively level-headed in terms of how to fight, stating that if one's excuse for a battle is to fight out of hatred, prejudice, or simple competition, as Nnoitra does, then it is merely instinctual and animalistic, and that it makes the challenger look "childish," "unworthy," and "not much of a warrior"

entries.name: Roka Paramia
entries.content: Roka Paramia is an Arrancar and was formerly a nurse in Sōsuke Aizen's affiliated army as well as a former Fracción of the 8th Espada Szayelaporro Granz.

entries.name: Choe Neng Poww
entries.content: Choe Neng Poww is the 25th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Baraggan Louisenbairn's six Fracción.

entries.name: Nirgge Parduoc
entries.content: Nirgge Parduoc is the 27th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Baraggan Louisenbairn's six Fracción.

entries.name: Abirama Redder
entries.content: Abirama Redder is the 22nd Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Baraggan Louisenbairn's six Fracción.

entries.name: Di Roy Rinker
entries.content: Di Roy Rinker is Arrancar Dieciséis (16) in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez's five Fracción.

entries.name: Zommari Rureaux
entries.content: Zommari Rureaux is an Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army, and the Séptima (7th) Espada.

entries.name: Cirucci Sanderwicci
entries.content: Cirucci Sanderwicci was the 105th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and a Privaron Espada prior to being killed by Rudbornn Chelute and later resurrected by Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

entries.name: Coyote Starrk
entries.content: Coyote Starrk is an Arrancar and the Primera (1st) Espada in Sōsuke Aizen's army, along with his other counterpart, Lilynette Gingerbuck.

entries.name: Cyan Sung-Sun
entries.content: Cyan Sung-Sun is the 56th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Tier Harribel's three Fracción, collectively known as the Tres Bestias. She wears a long white dress, with sleeves extending well past her hands. She wears two belts criss-crossing each other on her waist. Sung-Sun has long, flowing green hair, and three dots below her right eye. Her mask remnants create three hair clip-like extensions on the right side of her hair, and her Hollow hole is not visible. Her Zanpakutō resembles a sai.

entries.name: Ayon
entries.content: Ayon is a Hollow created by the Tres Bestias' Quimera Parca ability, made from Apacci, Mila Rose, and Sung-Sun's left arms. Despite being created by the three Arrancar, Ayon does not respond to any of their commands and tends to act on its own accord. Despite this, Ayon has shown some concern for their well-being.

entries.name: Quimera Parca
entries.content:
Quimera Parca is a collaborative technique used by the Arrancar Emilou Apacci, Franceska Mila Rose, and Cyan Sung-Sun. After viciously amputating the majority of their left arms, the three Arrancar combine these severed limbs to produce a creature of monstrous proportions named Ayon. This creature towers over average-size combatants and boasts considerable offensive abilities, possessing both inhuman endurance and immense physical strength. Despite some very limited sentience, Ayon is apparently ignorant to its creators' instructions. However, it does express a small amount of concern to their current conditions, only evidenced after they were severely injured.

Ayon's appearance is an amalgamation of elements taken from each Arrancar's appropriately themed Resurrección. These include a deer-skull for a nose, cloven-hoofed legs, a massive muscular torso, a long black mane, and a large serpent for a tail.

While this technique could originally only be performed once Mila Rose, Apacci, and Sung-Sun had each entered their respective Resurrección, in the time since Sōsuke Aizen's defeat and the ability's next use, they have gained the ability to execute it in the same manner even within their sealed forms.

entries.name: Ggio Vega
entries.content: Ggio Vega is the 26th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army and one of Baraggan Louisenbairn's six Fracción.

entries.name: Aisslinger Wernarr
entries.content: Aisslinger Wernarr, is the 17th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army, and one of the gatekeepers of Las Noches.

entries.name: Demoura Zodd
entries.content: Demoura Zodd is the 18th Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army. He is one of the guards for the underground passageways to Hueco Mundo.

entries.name: Cien Granz
entries.content: Cien Granz is an Arrancar and a clone of the Octava (8th) Espada, Szayelaporro Granz, made before the latter excised Yylfordt Granz from himself. He initially holds the rank of Arrancar Cien (100), but becomes the Cero (0) Espada after regaining his full power.

entries.name: The Pícaro
entries.content: The Pícaro (Rogue/Rascal) are a collective of childlike Arrancar that split off from a single Hollow, and were the 102nd Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army.

entries.name: Bawabawa
entries.content: Bawabawa is one of the combat spirits that Dondochakka Birstanne keeps in his stomach.

entries.name: Bulbous G
entries.content: Bulbous G is one of the Hollows who was attracted to the Human World by Uryū Ishida's Hollow Bait. After attacking Yasutora Sado and Karin Kurosaki, he was eventually destroyed by Sado's Fullbring.

entries.name: The Demi-Hollow
entries.content: The Demi-Hollow is a Hollow created from a Jibakurei (Earthbound Spirit) who was chained to an abandoned hospital in Karakura Town.

entries.name: Fishbone D
entries.content: Fishbone D is a Hollow who attacks the Kurosaki Clinic on the night Ichigo Kurosaki meets Rukia Kuchiki. He is subsequently purified by Ichigo after he receives Rukia's Shinigami powers.

entries.name: Grand Fisher
entries.content: Grand Fisher is a Hollow that had evaded Shinigami for 54 years and is responsible for the death of Ichigo Kurosaki's mother, Masaki Kurosaki. He later transformed into an imperfect Arrancar following his defeat at the hands of Ichigo, but was killed by Isshin Kurosaki.

entries.name: Hooleer
entries.content: Hooleer is a large Hollow in the service of Sōsuke Aizen.

entries.name: Hexapodus
entries.content: Hexapodus is a Hollow who was purified by Ichigo Kurosaki.

entries.name: The Menos Grande
entries.content: The Menos Grande is a Menos that ambushed Uryū Ishida in the Human World. Among its kind, it is unique in the way that its true form is composed of two separate Hollows that can act independently of one another.

entries.name: Metastacia
entries.content: Metastacia is an experimental Hollow used by Sōsuke Aizen an unknown number of years prior to his defection from Soul Society.

entries.name: Numb Chandelier
entries.content: Numb Chandelier is one of the Hollows who were attracted to Karakura Town by Uryū Ishida's Hollow Bait. After attacking many Karakura High School students, including Tatsuki Arisawa and Chizuru Honshō, Numb Chandelier was destroyed by Orihime Inoue's Shun Shun Rikka.

entries.name: Runuganga
entries.content: Runuganga is a giant Hollow who serves as the Guardian of the White Sands and acts under orders to protect Las Noches from intruders.

entries.name: Shrieker
entries.content: Shrieker is a Hollow who was originally an infamous serial killer in life. He was defeated by Ichigo Kurosaki and sent to Hell.

entries.name: Ikomikidomoe
entries.content: Ikomikidomoe was the name given to an ancient Adjuchas-class Hollow that was sealed inside a Zanpakutō by Ōetsu Nimaiya.

entries.name: Robert Accutrone
entries.content: Robert Accutrone is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "N".

entries.name: Lille Barro
entries.content:
Lille Barro is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "X" - "The X-Axis", as well as the leader of Yhwach's Schutzstaffe
l (Protective Echelon).

entries.name: Bambietta Basterbine
entries.content: Bambietta Basterbine is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "E" - "The Explode". Is the leader of the "Bambies".

entries.name: Bazzard Black
entries.content: Bazzard Black,more commonly known as Bazz-B, is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter, with the designation "H" - "The Heat".

entries.name: Driscoll Berci
entries.content: Driscoll Berci is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "O" - "The Overkill".

entries.name: BG9
entries.content: BG9 is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "K".

entries.name: Candice Catnipp
entries.content: Candice Catnipp is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "T" - The Thunderbolt. Also a member of the "Bambies".

entries.name: Shaz Domino
entries.content: Shaz Domino is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter army.

entries.name: Cang Du
entries.content: Cang Du is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "I" - "The Iron".

entries.name: Berenice Gabrielli
entries.content: Berenice Gabrielli is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "Q" - "The Question".

entries.name: Giselle Gewelle
entries.content: Giselle Gewelle is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "Z" - "The Zombie". Also member of the "Bambies".

entries.name: Jerome Guizbatt
entries.content: Jerome Guizbatt is a Quincy and member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "R" - "The Roar".

entries.name: Jugram Haschwalth
entries.content: Jugram Haschwalth is a Quincy and the Wandenreich's Sternritter Grandmaster with the designation "B" - "The Balance". He is also the advisor to Emperor Yhwach and the substitute as the monarch when Yhwach sleeps, as well as the second-in-command of the Wandenreich.

entries.name: Izumi Ishida
entries.content: Izumi Ishida was an Echt Quincy as well as the wife of Sōken Ishida, the mother of Ryūken Ishida, the mother-in-law of Kanae Ishida and the paternal grandmother of Uryū Ishida.

entries.name: Ryūken Ishida
entries.content: Ryūken Ishida is an Echt Quincy who is the son of Sōken Ishida and father of Uryū Ishida. He is the Director of the Karakura Hospital and also known as 'The Last Quincy'; a title contested by his son.

entries.name: Sōken Ishida
entries.content: Sōken Ishida was an Echt Quincy as well as the father of Ryūken Ishida, the father-in-law of Kanae Ishida and the paternal grandfather of Uryū Ishida.

entries.name: Uryū Ishida
entries.content: Uryū Ishida is a Gemischt Quincy residing in Karakura Town. He is a doctor at Karakura Hospital, and a friend of Ichigo Kurosaki. He is a former member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "A" - "Antithesis", formerly one of Yhwach's Schutzstaffel and was once designated as his future successor.

entries.name: James
entries.content: James is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "S" - "The Superstar", which he uses to empower his fellow Sternritter, Mask De Masculine.

entries.name: Kanae Katagiri
entries.content: Kanae Katagiri was a Gemischt Quincy and a former maid in the service of the Ishida family. She later became the wife of Ryūken Ishida and the mother of Uryū Ishida.

entries.name: Masaki Kurosaki
entries.content: Masaki Kurosaki was an Echt Quincy, the wife of Isshin Kurosaki, and mother of Ichigo Kurosaki, Karin Kurosaki, and Yuzu Kurosaki. She was the last surviving member of her family, and was taken in by the Ishida family before an incident with a Hollow led her to live a life with Isshin. She had died to the hollow Grand Fisher after being weakened by Yhwach's Auswählen.

entries.name: Liltotto Lamperd
entries.content: Liltotto Lamperd is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "G" - "The Glutton". Also a member of "The Bambies".

entries.name: Guenael Lee
entries.content: Guenael Lee is a creation of Gremmy Thoumeaux's The Visionary ability, though he introduces himself as a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "V - Vanishing Point".

entries.name: Loyd Lloyd
entries.content: Loyd Lloyd is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "Y" - "The Yourself". He is the older identical twin brother of Royd Lloyd.

entries.name: Royd Lloyd
entries.content: Royd Lloyd is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "Y" - "The Yourself". He is the younger identical twin brother of Loyd Lloyd.

entries.name: Mask De Masculine
entries.content: Mask De Masculine is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "S" - "The Superstar".

entries.name: Meninas McAllon
entries.content: Meninas McAllon is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "P" - "The Power". Also a member of the "Bambies"

entries.name: NaNaNa Najahkoop
entries.content: NaNaNa Najahkoop is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "U" - The Underbelly.

entries.name: Askin Nakk Le Vaar
entries.content: Askin Nakk Le Vaar is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "D" - "The Deathdealing". He is the only lower-ranking Sternritter to be promoted to Yhwach's Schutzstaffel.

entries.name: Äs Nödt
entries.content: Äs Nödt is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "F" - "The Fear".

entries.name: Quilge Opie
entries.content: Quilge Opie is the executive hunting captain of the first Jagdarmee of the Wandenreich. He is also a member of the Sternritter with the designation "J" - "The Jail", and is known as Quilge Opie of "the Jail".

entries.name: Pernida Parnkgjas
entries.content: Pernida Parnkgjas is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "C" - "The Compulsory", as well as one of Yhwach's Schutzstaffel. It is also the left hand of the Soul King. Pernida governs "Progress" and its counterpart is Mimihagi.

entries.name: Gremmy Thoumeaux
entries.content: Gremmy Thoumeaux is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "V" - "The Visionary".

entries.name: Gerard Valkyrie
entries.content: Gerard Valkyrie is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "M" - The Miracle, as well as one of Yhwach's Schutzstaffel. He is also the heart of the Soul King.

entries.name: PePe Waccabrada
entries.content: PePe Waccabrada is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "L" - "The Love".

entries.name: Nianzol Weizol
entries.content: Nianzol Weizol is a Quincy and a member of the Wandenreich's Sternritter with the designation "W" - "The Wind".

entries.name: Yhwach
entries.content: Yhwach, often referred to simply as "Your Majesty" by his underlings, is the Father of the Quincy and the emperor of the Wandenreich, with the designation "A" - "The Almighty". He is the son of the Soul King.

entries.name: Mimihagi
entries.content: Mimihagi is a fallen deity that operates in the outer areas of Eastern Rukongai and is the right hand of the Soul King. Mimihagi governs "Stillness", and its counterpart is Pernida Parnkgjas.

entries.name: Kon
entries.content: Kon is an Underpod Modified Soul created during Project Spearhead. His name is short for Kaizō Konpaku (Modified soul). Kon typically inhabits a stuffed lion, but occasionally doubles as a Soul Candy pill for Ichigo Kurosaki, taking charge of Ichigo's Human body.

entries.name: Jin Kariya
entries.content: Jin Kariya is the leader of the remaining Bount. He was originally named Eugene Currier, but adopted a Japanese-style name later in his life.

entries.name: Ashisogi Jizō (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Ashisogi Jizō is the manifested spirit of Mayuri Kurotsuchi's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Gegetsuburi (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Gegetsuburi is the manifested spirit of Marechiyo Ōmaeda's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Gonryōmaru (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Gonryōmaru is the manifested spirit of Chōjirō Sasakibe's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Haineko (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Haineko is the manifested spirit of Rangiku Matsumoto's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Hisagomaru (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Hisagomaru is the manifested spirit of Hanatarō Yamada's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Hōzukimaru (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Hōzukimaru is the manifested spirit of Ikkaku Madarame's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Hyōrinmaru (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Hyōrinmaru is the manifested spirit of Tōshirō Hitsugaya's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Katen Kyōkotsu (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Katen Kyōkotsu is the manifested spirit of Shunsui Kyōraku's Zanpakutō, and takes the form of two separate individuals.

entries.name: Kazeshini (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Kazeshini is the manifested spirit of Shūhei Hisagi's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Minazuki (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Minazuki is the manifested spirit of Retsu Unohana's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Muramasa (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Muramasa is a Zanpakutō spirit with the power to release other Zanpakutō spirits from their owners. He was the orchestrator of the Zanpakutō Rebellion.

entries.name: Nozarashi (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Nozarashi is the manifested spirit of Kenpachi Zaraki's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Ruri'iro Kujaku (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Ruri'iro Kujaku is the manifested spirit of Yumichika Ayasegawa's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Ryūjin Jakka (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Ryūjin Jakka is the manifested spirit of Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Senbonzakura (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Senbonzakura is the manifested spirit of Byakuya Kuchiki's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Sode no Shirayuki (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Sode no Shirayuki is the manifested spirit of Rukia Kuchiki's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Sōgyo no Kotowari (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Sōgyo no Kotowari is the manifested spirit of Jūshirō Ukitake's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Suzumebachi (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Suzumebachi is the manifested spirit of Suì-Fēng's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Tenken (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Tenken is the manifested spirit of Sajin Komamura's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Tobiume (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Tobiume is the manifested spirit of Momo Hinamori's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Wabisuke (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Wabisuke is the manifested spirit of Izuru Kira's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Zabimaru (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Zabimaru is the manifested spirit of Renji Abarai's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Zangetsu (Quincy Powers)
entries.content: The old man whom Ichigo Kurosaki acknowledged as Zangetsu is the manifested spirit of Ichigo Kurosaki's Quincy powers that can be found inside Ichigo's inner world.

entries.name: Zangetsu (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content:
Zangetsu (Slaying Moon) is the manifested spirit of Ichigo Kurosaki's Zanpakutō as well as his inner Hollow. He has been variously called Hollow Ichigo, more properly called The Hollow within Ichigo,  or White Ichigo.

Zangetsu is the result of the fusion between the Hollow White that Ichigo inherited from his mother and the Shinigami powers he inherited from his father.

entries.name: Urozakuro (Zanpakutō spirit)
entries.content: Urozakuro (Rain and Dew Pomegranate) is the manifested spirit of Sōya Azashiro's Zanpakutō.

entries.name: Arkvine
entries.content: Arkvine is a close subordinate of Sullivan. He is a tall, dark-skinned man with light-colored, close-shaven hair and dark facial hair consisting of a mustache connected to a medium-size beard tapering to a point at his chin and with a strip of hair below his lower lip. He wears a black suit, connected at the front by a thin chain, over a white dress shirt and black tie, with a light-colored sash over his waist and dark pants, and carries a sword with a long handle.

entries.name: Bruno Bangnyfe
entries.content: Bruno Bangnyfe is the Director of the Inks division of Wing Bind.

entries.name: Billy Banx Jr.
entries.content: Billy Banx Jr. is a member of the Pipers of Wing Bind and Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole's commanding officer. He was briefly a member of the Sabres until he was demoted for laziness.

entries.name: Roy B. Dipper
entries.content: Roy B. Dipper is the Director of the Anthems division of Wing Bind.

entries.name: Cquntnire Milieve
entries.content: Cquntnire Milieve is the Director of the Sacreds division of Wing Bind.

entries.name: Noel Niihashi
entries.content: Noel Niihashi is a Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Ninny Spangcole.

entries.name: Harry Shayk
entries.content: Harry Shayk is the Director of the Billionaires division of Wing Bind.

entries.name: Wolfgang Slashhaut
entries.content: Wolfgang Slashhaut is the Director of the Gallows division of Wing Bind.

entries.name: Ninny Spangcole
entries.content: Ninny Spangcole is a Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Noel Niihashi. Ninny is also a singer in the band Cecile Die Twice , having performed alongside Macy Baljure.

entries.name: Sullivan Squire
entries.content: Sullivan Squire is the Director of the Sabres division of Wing Bind.

entries.name: Tronbone Takkinen
entries.content: Tronbone Takkinen is the Director of the Pipers division of Wing Bind.

entries.name: Macy Baljure
entries.content: Macy Baljure is a former lead singer of the band Cecile Die Twice, having performed alongside Ninny Spangcole. She is also a Watcher and a Dragonclad.

entries.name: Cinderella
entries.content: Cinderella is one of the seven Märchens of Reverse London. She was found and formerly adopted as a pet by Macy Baljure, who had nicknamed her Elly.

entries.name: Osushi
entries.content: Osushi is a Dragon masquerading as Balgo Parks's pet dog in London.

entries.name: Balgo Parks
entries.content: Balgo Ywain Parks is a Human who became a Dragonclad after living with Shelby for 10 years and being bitten by him. He is currently looked after by Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole.

entries.name: Rickenbacker
entries.content: Rickenbacker is Bruno's Dragon mount. He is a large, indigo-skinned Dragon whose narrow and jagged head has an upward-curving snout ending in a point, with narrow, light-blue eyes and two long horns jutting backward from the top of his head, as well as four muscular legs ending in three front talons and a single back talon each, four wings shaped like Khyber knives, and a long tail with multiple spikes leading up to the tip, facing in different directions. Rickenbacker can teleport to Bruno's location in a flurry of dark energy when his name is called, damaging the immediate surroundings, and is durable enough to simply smash through protective barriers like Cloth.

entries.name: Shelby
entries.content: Shelby is a Disguiser Dragon that has lived in London for 10 years, masquerading as Balgo Parks's childhood friend.

entries.name: Magic Masters
entries.content: Magic masters possess advanced knowledge of various spells. They can use powerful spells to great effect without reciting the incantation or even the name.

entries.name: Magic Experts
entries.content: Magic experts possess considerable knowledge of various spells. They can use mid-level spells to great effect even without incantation, though they generally use incantations for higher-level spells to ensure maximum power.

entries.name: Dragon Species
entries.content: There are several different species of Dragon, and many of them have been domesticated by the residents of Reverse London to produce various goods and resources; these species are collectively referred to as Light Dragons.

entries.name: Broombuggy
entries.content: Broombuggy: Small, winged Dragons with two legs and smooth bodies that end in large tails, Broombuggies are used for transport by members of Wing Bind[9] and can reach high speeds while flying. They feed on grass.

entries.name: Woolly Wally
entries.content: Woolly Wally: Large, shaggy, goat-like dragons with four chicken-like legs, drooping ears, and three visible ridges on their snouts. They produce textiles.

entries.name: Hammerback
entries.content: Hammerback: Large, alligator-like Dragons covered in jagged protrusions shaped like rock plateaus with a bone-like plate at the end of their snout that defines their nose. They produce minerals.

entries.name: Conductor Dragon
entries.content: Conductor: Medium-sized, furry, ball-like Dragons with multiple legs and two electric towers sticking out of their backs. They generate electricity.

entries.name: Matchbox Dragon
entries.content: Matchbox: Small, dog-like Dragons that appear to be constantly on fire. They produce fuel.

entries.name: Blue Appetite Dragon
entries.content: Blue Appetite: Medium-sized Dragons composed of several eyes joined by membranes with anemone-like protrusions hanging off of them. They produce medicines.

entries.name: Meatball Dragon
entries.content: Meatball: Very small, round, pig-like Dragons with long and thin noses. They are harvested for meat.

entries.name: Planty Potty
entries.content: Planty Potty: Small, light-colored Dragons that resemble ceramic vases and pots but differ in overall appearance between individuals aside from a tiny pair of bat-like wings. They are used for plant cultivation.

entries.name: Chariot Dragon
entries.content: Chariot: Long, thin, light-colored Dragons with a pair of fan-like wings, a head shaped like the mouthpiece of a flute, four tiny legs, and a small ornament on the ends of their tails. They function as radio wave boosters when hooked up to a power cable.

entries.name: Butter Case Dragon
